summary: Robert Alai Onyango is the Member of County Assembly (MCA) for Kileleshwa Ward in the Nairobi City County Assembly. Formerly an influential digital activist and blogger, Alai serves as a vocal legislative watchdog in the assembly, spearheading committee probes into county executive procurement, solid waste management tenders, and unapproved urban zoning.
introduction: Robert Alai Onyango was elected to the Nairobi City County Assembly in August 2022 representing Kileleshwa Ward on an ODM ticket. Leveraging a national profile built over a decade of investigative blogging and public whistleblowing, Alai has used the floor of the County Assembly to challenge executive procurement irregularities. Key oversight actions include challenging inflated billing for County Assembly chamber biometric voting systems, demanding accountability for multi-million shilling garbage collection contracts, and opposing irregular commercial high-rise developments in residential zones.
